decisions.summary: hamlet_burial knob: own_ground or village_ground, even odds (a guess), pin honored, nonsense refused
decisions.why: This is the GM's own fallback: a per-hamlet knob where some hamlets have their own graveyard and some do not. 540, 210, the class and burial.py all carry it.

decisions.summary: The plan's Summary says 'a RULE, not a knob - every hamlet draws a burial ground of its own', and the Constitution Check XVI says 'a rule because the evidence agrees'
decisions.why: Stale text from round 1, and it contradicts D1. As written, the plan still states the rule round 1 ruled NOT LEGITIMATE, which drops the form the GM named ('go into the village to visit your ancestors'). A plan that states both the rule and the knob is not clear to implement from. The fix is to rewrite both lines to the knob.

decisions.summary: Size within 160's 750-2,450 sq ft full-body band by households, 1.4:1, labeled a guess
decisions.why: It is relabeled as a guess in the plan, in 540 and in the class. burial.py's module docstring still says 'accurate as a band', so the point of change disagrees with the plan and must be relabeled.

decisions.summary: Nearest clear seat from the middle of the houses, fall line breaking ties; 60 ft from houses and wells; 180's water set-backs; _fits
decisions.why: It agrees with 540 ('as near the houses as those allow, below them where it can'; 60 ft, a guess). Round 1's mismatch is resolved.

decisions.summary: An own_ground hamlet with no clear seat within the reach (700 ft in code) draws no ground; the manifest records 'no seat'
decisions.why: The ground cannot be seated when nothing within the reach clears. The case is recorded in the manifest rather than hidden. It stays legitimate only while it is the exception: if it fires on a pool hamlet, report it, because on the map an own_ground hamlet with no ground looks like the village_ground form.

decisions.summary: The village cremation ground carries all of 530: the seat knob, the edge downstream, 120 ft, 30 px from water, the fire bed off the shrine approach, within ~650 ft, six jizo; jizo off by default elsewhere
decisions.why: It matches 530's 'rule the map follows' clause by clause. The jizo default of off touches only maps outside this request. 'Beside' falls back to 'on its own' until a burial ground exists, and the manifest records it; 530 allows both seats.

decisions.summary: The knob lives in hamletgen only; roll.py's hamlet tier is legacy; the no-village-features roll test covers both generators
decisions.why: The live hamlets are hamletgen's. The test covers FR-003's MUST NOT for both generators.

decisions.summary: The in-field grave island is left unchanged, as a separate liberty
decisions.why: The spec's edge case asks only that the feature say whether the rule changes the field graves. It says that it does not, and why.

decisions.summary: T06 builds the village burial ground if 269's 270 and 280 are on main, or is ticked by claiming the follow-up feature
decisions.why: This is the spec's edge case, now a task. The Phases line 'The village burial ground (D5) is a follow-up feature once 269 lands' is still unconditional and should read as T06 does.

decisions.summary: Pool hamlets that draw a ground re-roll; one settlement-review per moved map
160's hamlet clause and village band are 269's to rewrite to the knob
decisions.why: The agreement exists: diagram-supplemental's specs/269-research-backfill/briefs/extra/r1-amend-160.md carries the exact replacement. 160 contradicts 540 until that lands, and 269's entry-drift owns that.
